facts.fact: DLA Piper reports a Cybersecurity Bill (version 6 of 15 September 2023, on INTIC's site) still under discussion, to make INTIC the national cybersecurity authority and set fines.
DLA Piper reports the Penal Code (Law 24/2019, amended by Law 17/2020) provides cybercrimes such as database intrusion (up to two years) and electronic fraud (one to five years).
